name: Quiz Game: Kim's Scout Training
source:
Kim, a teenage high school class representative has to attend a boy scout training conducted by his classmate Alejandro.

Will Kim earn his badges?

Will Alejandro reward or punish Kim?

[From [url=https://purple-bear.itch.io/quiz-game]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
金是一名青少年高中班级代表，必须参加他的同学亚历杭德罗举办的童子军培训。

金会赢得他的徽章吗？

亚历杭德罗会奖励还是惩罚金？

[来自[url=https://purple-bear.itch.io/quiz-game]Itch.io[/url]]
